findings.title: Reject booleans when reading integer config values
findings.description: Description: `bool` is a subclass of `int`, so `get_typed_config(..., int)` accepts a TOML boolean for an integer key. For example, setting `pipeline.background_idle_timeout_s = true` can be treated as a one-second timeout instead of producing a type error. Explicitly exclude booleans from the integer check.

findings.title: Detect an explicitly empty system prompt on the session path
findings.description: Description: The session-path guard checks the truthiness of `context.params.get("system_prompt")`. A step that explicitly supplies `system_prompt: ""` bypasses the guard, even though the session cannot apply a per-step prompt and the action will silently use the session prompt instead. Check whether the parameter is present, rather than whether its value is truthy.

findings.title: Check session usability before changing its model
findings.description: Description: A failed reconnect sets `unusable_reason`, but `set_model()` does not check it. The session dispatch path calls `set_model()` before `dispatch()`, so a later step can attempt an SDK operation on the failed client before reaching the usability check, potentially masking the recorded reconnect failure. Require usability before invoking the client.

findings.title: Escape agent text before rendering it as Rich markup
findings.description: Description: This appends agent-generated text to `ActionResult.error`. The CLI later interpolates that error into `rprint` markup in `src/squadron/cli/commands/run.py:561`, so markup in the response tail can alter terminal rendering or trigger markup parsing errors. Escape the agent text or render the error as plain text.

findings.title: Add a load test for SDK background waiting
findings.description: Description: This change adds a network-backed async stream-waiting and task-stopping path, but the existing `tests/load/` suite has no coverage for SDK dispatches. Add a load test that exercises realistic background-task waiting and checks a resource or latency bound, as required for network and concurrency paths.

structured_findings.summary: Reject booleans when reading integer config values
Detect an explicitly empty system prompt on the session path
Check session usability before changing its model
